format: Exact zero-based original-line splices; no offsets or fuzz. Lines include original terminators.

before:
if (capabilities.tokenSource !== "none") return "authenticated";
  // API keys can authenticate with tokenSource: none; also check key and account fields.

after:
if (hasToken || hasApiKey || capabilities.email || capabilities.subscriptionType) return "authenticated";
  return capabilities.tokenSource === "none" ? "unauthenticated" : "unknown";

status: customApiEndpoint ? "unknown" : claudeAuthStatus(capabilities),
        ...(!customApiEndpoint && capabilities.email ? { email: capabilities.email } : {}),
